method.notes: Three consecutive windows in one run, not independent-run confidence intervals. Each animated mode resets the pose epoch; poses sampled differ with frame rate. Fixed P mode reuses the cached geometry after optimization. HUD/BGM/VSync remain enabled. Intermediate AB/ABC benchmark inputs were already masked; the general demo parameter-mask bug was fixed before ABCD.

bit_exact_rom_comparison.method: Decode the freshly rebuilt baseline ROM and the final optimized ROM independently; compare all raster bytes and expand all merged runs to the original records.
